data.name: Blood Scent
data.description: If you have performed your daily obedience, three times per day, you can cast blood scent (Advanced Race Guide p.143) on yourself as a spell-like ability. This ability does not grant the spell's bonus on attack and damage rolls, even if you are an orc or have a rage ability.
